title: Make schema Beads-compatible: dependencies.dep_type -> type with auto-migration
description:
Currently bees uses dependencies.dep_type while Beads uses dependencies.type. This breaks the design intent of 'drop in a beads.db and bees just works'. Pointing bees daemon at an existing Beads DB causes SQLITE_ERROR on list/ready operations.

Fix: rename the column in bees source to type, update views, add idempotent migration in schema.init() so existing bees DBs auto-upgrade on next open.

Discovered while debugging the Beads VS Code extension panel error 'internal error: SQLITE_ERROR' against the homelab project's migrated .bees/bees.db.
close_reason: Implemented in src/db/schema.zig (DROP VIEW + ALTER TABLE RENAME COLUMN dep_type TO type, catch-protected; views recreated to use d.type) and src/db/store.zig (SQL strings updated, type AS dep_type aliases preserve Zig struct fields). Migration runs idempotently on every openDb()/daemon start. Verified: homelab .bees/bees.db now responds OK to list/ready operations that previously returned SQLITE_ERROR. All 49 tests pass.
